HARBOR LABS SAMPLE RECORD. Fictional: every name, date and number is invented.
Page 1 of 1
Records for qualified small business stock under Section 1202, note from Ada
Auditor, CPA
The company became a C corporation on June 2, 2011. Only stock issued after that
date can qualify.
Gross assets were about $1.5 million right after the Series Seed closing, under the
$50 million limit in Section 1202.
Keep a yearly schedule of gross assets, proof of the business activity, and the date
and price of each stock issuance.
This note describes the records to keep. Whether a holder qualifies is decided on
that holder's own return.
